whole_lifecycle_findings: One whole dynamic composite-lens and inverse split lifecycle at most, not one credit per lens/property/serializer/native helper. This study is applicable NBT functional-variant/crafting research, pending independent review0; migration1000 and machine-only quest structural1000 do not authorize new NBT production.

Composite matches occupied slots: exactly two CompositableLensItem stacks and one LENS_GLUE stack, not physical stack counts. Multiple units in one slot do not become multiple ingredients. Slot encounter order chooses outer/base versus nested lens. No output or consumption occurs in matches.

Composite matches does not itself run compatibility. assemble may return EMPTY after a matches=true preview path. It invokes the first lens canCombineLenses and forbids existing composite on either side. Interface prose is not evidence that both custom implementations are called reciprocally.

LensItem compatibility checks distinct item identity, both non-normal combinable lenses, and no overlapping property bits. PROP_NONE zero-bit lenses can combine with other zero-bit lenses if distinct items. These are parameters of one policy, not independent implementations.

assemble copies base and second count1; setCompositeLens serializes the second stack into the compositeLens compound of the base copy. Base custom metadata follows copy; nested stack item/count/tag and Forge caps follow native save/ItemStack.of supporting code. Names, tooltip and base item ID do not prove functional composite NBT.

Split accepts exactly one occupied lens slot whose getCompositeLens is nonempty. It returns a count1 copy of nested lens. getRemainingItems separately copies the base count1 and removes only compositeLens; outer and nested unrelated metadata have copy semantics. Glue is not refunded by this split; native ResultSlot delivers remainder. This is inverse composition, not minting two outputs without an original paid stack.

Split getRemainingItems lacks its own full valid-grid guard; normal RecipeManager selects a matching recipe before invoking it. Callback reentry/mutation and malicious direct invocation have not been executed or proven safe. Never call assemble/getRemainingItems to award a quest reward or migrate inventory.

ItemNBTHelper.getCompound checks key existence rather than compound type; malformed entry handling is inherited getCompound and ItemStack.of. Native of catches RuntimeException and returns EMPTY. Do not claim arbitrary corrupted/unknown item payload is preserved, or removed item IDs remain recoverable.

Lens effects dispatch outer then nested BasicLens effects for apply/collide/update. Controlled spreader methods delegate primary lens only. This source binds functional readers but does not prove every burst/property combination or running visuals. None of those implementations is a separate credit.

Concrete NoOpRecipeSerializer registrations and specialRecipe datagen map serializer registry keys to dynamic/composite_lens and dynamic/split_lens IDs. Constructor-only JSON/network serializer has no per-recipe dynamic fields. Forge datagen glue requests slimeballs tag plus honey bottle; raw generated recipe/tag bodies absent, current loaded tags/recipes unverified.

Native server CraftingMenu.slotChangedCraftingGrid binds chosen recipe, evaluates assemble and enabled output before sync. CustomRecipe catalog getResultItem EMPTY is not a missing craft result. Recipe preview/JEI/string name alone is not native crafting completion.

Native ResultSlot.checkTakeAchievements calls onCraftedBy, Forge crafted event and recipe award/trigger before onTake removes one ingredient per occupied slot and processes remainders. Native shift-click calls item onCraftedBy even before destination move success. Those early item callbacks are not an after-payment exactly-once committed receipt.

Native RecipeHolder.awardUsedRecipes invokes triggerRecipeCrafted for special as well as ordinary recipes before its special book-unlock branch. SpecialRecipeBuilder emits no recipe advancement itself, yet a separate recipe_crafted criterion may still observe its recipe ID. Never infer special means no trigger.

RecipeCraftedTrigger input predicates match copies of input stacks with per-predicate removal; recipe ID and ingredient predicates are in this trigger, output stack is absent. A future four-variant quest must bind an exact intended recipe/native result path; broad base-item/generic first_infusion cannot certify arbitrary output variant NBT. Current Dynasty has no new quest/serializer edits from this study.

Existing accepted migration item-flags legacy booleans, Brewery paid mana+inventory recomputation, and RunicAltar paid mana+rune refund decisions are fully read here. Composite/split final item-owned functional payload differs from their durable machine-state migrations; shared ItemNBTHelper/ItemStack serialization has zero new migration credit. No composite/split terms appeared in either current ledger; this bounded screen is not a claim to re-read every accepted record.

whole_lifecycle_findings.finding: Wrapper stores inner FinishedRecipe and a CompoundTag, emits nested complete recipe plus SNBT string, preserves inner ID and advancement JSON/ID but changes datagen type to wrapper. with() creates one tag object per returned consumer, shared by emitted wrappers and not copied here. Eight tiara recipes are parameter variants of this one mechanism, not eight credits.

Wrapper serializer parses inner recipe under the SAME resource ID then parses required nbt string and setTag replaces its live getResultItem(RegistryAccess.EMPTY) tag. Missing nbt/invalid SNBT raises JsonSyntaxException. It returns inner recipe, not a durable wrapper recipe. Correctness requires inner result getter live/constant and usable with EMPTY registry; special recipes returning EMPTY or computed copies are not justified. Deprecated two-argument RecipeManager.fromJson supplies EMPTY Forge condition context; no proof it propagates outer dynamic condition context.

Inner shapeless recipe stores live result, returns it from getter, assemble copies result including deep ordinary tag and serialized capabilities. Inputs are NOT copied into output; output variant is fixed. Existing enchant/custom name/input variant/damage/capabilities are not merged from consumed tiara. Any registered wrapper used on a dynamic/copy-return getter needs separate proof.

Fixed base tiara Item ID is shared; runtime getter reads integer variant default0. Eight distinct quartz ingredients determine separate recipe IDs and static variant1..8. Item-only ingredient does not require prior variant and is not a record of original crafter. Creation-tab variants are catalog sources, not survival payment receipts.

Author also wraps a player-head result with SkullOwner and a16-pink-petal recipe. PetalsRecipe getter returns live output, assemble copies and serializer writes its result using own PETAL serializer. Its matches breaks at first empty slot, one ingredient per visited occupied stack, not generic arbitrary sparse-container matching. Apothecary BE payment/credit/thrower path was NOT reread for this proposal; this example supports template wrapper0 only, not a separate mechanic/transaction acceptance.

Update packet chooses returned inner recipe.getSerializer, so wrapper own network methods deliberately throwing do not establish broken sync for shown live inner result. Normal shapeless/Petal serializers send result ItemStack. Forge writeItem uses share tag conditional on item damageability/override; Item default override=true and default IForgeItem share/read use ordinary stack tag. Custom overrides can omit data; no unconditional full-capability/client-NBT fidelity or actual TCP runtime claim.

whole_lifecycle_findings: Type registration, builder conversion and JSON/packet parser bind NBT_COPY to NBTCopyRecipe before populating output/options; unknown recipe_class uses DEFAULT identity converter. Declared bootstrap is not proof of runtime registration or deployment.

NBTCopyRecipe scans all altar inventory stacks against all search Ingredients. Every matching tagged stack adds a copied ordinary tag with no early break, so overlapping predicates may add it twice. It does not copy complete ItemStack.save/caps/count ownership.

Each output is a copied configured template; recursive merge then mutates output tags. Compounds recurse; same-tag-type lists equality-union, mismatched type replaces; int/long/byte arrays with true deduplicate values; scalar values overwrite from later input tags. No schema/clamp/ench-level-normalization or arbitrary key iteration guarantee.

Domic and ichosic upgrade builders are two parameters of one mechanism. Configured outputs unlock STARLIGHT plus AREA_SIZE or FLUID_FIELDS, select that mode; input upgrades union with output list, but input selected_upgrade scalar may overwrite desired output default. Functional ItemResonator reader clamps selection and requires unlocked mode plus progression, falling back to STARLIGHT when denied.

Inherited getOutputForRender returns first copied static template without input NBT scan. Constellation subclass runs same merged-output policy before optional constellation setter on compatible output items; render adds constellation only. This subclass/helpers/examples each add0.

Simple recipe gate checks initiating player progression, altar tier, optional constellation, starlight availability and Ingredient grid with no unrelated occupied extras. Native1.16 Ingredient/progression/energy lower engines are not expanded; no exact-NBT match or actual starlight debit receipt implied.

Active task persists crafterUUID/ticks/total/state/focus stacks/craftingData; reload resolves current recipe ID, absent/invalid recipe manager returns null. Tile separately reads inventory/focus/knownRecipes/active task. No clamped ordinal/UUID/parser recovery, output commit journal or exactly-once crash safety is shown.

Ordinary cycle validates matches(false,false), then finished state; relay actual inputs are checked differently with testNecessaryRelayInputs=true after finish. Additional relay inputs begin duration/3 despite comment66%; delivered goal/server updates are not strict wall seconds or tested scheduling.

finishRecipe sets Forge crafting player, creates outputs, consumes inputs, clears crafting player without try/finally. Per-output ResearchManager notification precedes output consumer. Server initiating player lookup gates advancement notification, not actual player pickup or payment.

Drop wrapper creates new ItemEntity with zero motion, ignores world.addEntity return, sets20tick pickup delay afterwards and returns object. No target/owner or verified inventory transfer. Native1.16 world/cross-mod admission and pickup remain unexpanded; no same UUID acquisition evidence.

Payment visits25slots; fluid result updates slot only if tryEmptyContainer succeeds, missing relay tile is skipped. Ordinary decrement copies stack and shrinks copy. In different-container/nonempty branch it emits remainder without writing decremented copy into slot in shown code. This limits transactional claims; no exploit or runtime loss has been tested.

After output/debit, successful chaining branch keeps same finished active object without shown tick reset/replacement; source-local observation only, not confirmed repeated-output/rate/exploit. Later errors/callers/cross-mod behavior unexecuted.

whole_lifecycle_findings: One whole typed-fragment consensus -> shaped recipe -> dynamic output identity -> functional item consumer policy at most. Six complete classes and two bounded registration/datagen contexts are evidence, not eight credits; species/recipe parameters never separate credits.

Concrete MobCharmRecipeBuilder uses six fragment occupied slots in FLF/FSF/F F, leather-tag L and string-tag S; ModRecipeProvider saves with CharmEnabledCondition. Charm and fragment IDs remain mob_charm and mob_charm_fragment rather than one ID per entity. Config condition raw body/current generated JSON not inspected.

MobCharmRecipe.matches first requires the delegated ShapedRecipe match then hasOnlyOneFragmentType. Helper visits only exact fragment items, comparing the getter ResourceLocations, not all arbitrary input metadata, count, owner or damage.

Fragment getter has getOrDefault(ENTITY_NAME, default entity registry key), not required-presence validation. An untagged fragment and explicitly default-key fragment can compare equal. No proof invalid/unknown logical entity keys are rejected by this matching predicate.

assemble delegates to shaped result creation then writes the FIRST matching fragment getter value if present. It does not itself re-run matches or charge materials. Normal engine selection must supply validity; direct invocation and payment cannot be inferred from assemble.

Only ENTITY_NAME identity is transferred. Input stack names, damage, other data components, ownership and arbitrary NBT are not blanket-merged. Modern shaped output behavior beyond the shown call has not been read from the same game version.

Fragment getStackFor constructs its own item then sets ENTITY_NAME. Datagen blaze/cave-spider/creeper/enderman examples are source identity/material parameter variants of the same policy; no independent four credits.

ModDataComponents registers entity_name persistent ResourceLocation.CODEC and networkSynchronized ResourceLocation.STREAM_CODEC. This shows serialization declarations, not loaded protocol success, durability through current Dynasty save/pack or native acquisition.

MobCharmItem.isCharmFor requires exact MOB_CHARM item AND matching component getter, while inventory scans collect identity keys and cache by player UUID for one game-time value. Thus a base icon or untranslated name cannot alone prove a named functional variant.

MobCharm runtime defensive target cancellation/reset and death durability consumers are read context only, not new immunity evidence. Pedestal, player-inventory API, registry definitions, target event lifecycle and effect outcomes have not been expanded; no denial/kill/payment exploit claim.

Builder.save constructs an advancement with criteria/rewards but calls recipeOutput.accept(id, recipe, null). ensureValid requires nonempty criteria, yet this body does not emit that constructed advancement; unlockedBy name alone is not proof of player unlock or quest completion.

Serializer delegates shaped codec/stream and maps constructor both directions; REGISTERED_RECIPES adds each constructed recipe. No cleanup/reload caller inspected; cannot infer leak, actual reload replacement, exactly-once entry or absent networking problem from this set alone.
